FT-002.adaptation: Accepted FT-002 revision 3 (stage 3: dependency-aware invalidation and cached reuse) at input main 60ceb5c, allocation openai-kabir-plus-ft002-stage3. Groundwork already exists: a Session with byte-diff block reuse and ReuseStats was built on this machine during stage 2 and deliberately NOT merged, because its own equivalence test caught real drift between its private copy of the layout engine and the real one once math landed. Stage 3 makes that fix in scope: layout.rs will be refactored into a resumable cursor so there is one layout engine, then reuse drives it. Macro definitions are state, so a macro change must invalidate every dependent block - that is the dependency-aware part of this revision and goes beyond the earlier byte-diff prototype.

origin/main.adaptation: Reviewed the worker output rather than accepting its self-report: confirmed compile_full is a genuine clean parse-and-layout so the byte-identical equivalence assertion is real, and confirmed the private layout copy is gone.
